about: The catalogue cases of the control-flow findings that recording batches have taken on (ADR 0012: E3d records CF-2 to CF-15; E3e records the rest). Each is cited by a recorded run of a control-flow fixture, or deferred with the milestone that takes it and why. TestRecordingBatchCoverage in internal/oracle enforces it.

deferred.reason: it reads the deployed flow back with wmill sync pull; the harness pushes and runs but has no pull read-back yet (OR-8 covers the push)

a raw submission or a version whose dependency job failed: outside the reference configuration, where windmill-lite applies the deployed defaults (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 7, Q-CF-13); the harness runs deployed flows by path only
a raw parent submission (Q-CF-15): windmill-lite never runs raw submissions, so ADR 0001 section 6 needs no recording; the harness runs deployed flows by path only

partial.missing: the raw-submission comparison run ([-999,-998,-997]); only the by-path half, the reference configuration, is recorded
the pending-dependency and raw-submission comparison runs; only the by-path run after a successful dependency job is recorded, with the outer body's job kind in the provenance
